g.text: Frozen Bolt contribution: limited full-history linear controls
Fixed: same final P/E/D + full 512-step latent history. Joint: fresh no-Bolt objective, same architecture.
PeMS has a fixed head only; parent limited to 1 epoch, added head 3 epochs. No universal Bolt-necessity claim.
C170 results do not fill the new C32/K8 matched experiment.
